entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:1
segments: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and, behold, the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:2
segments: Wherefore I praised the dead that have been long dead more than the living that are yet alive;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:3
segments: yea, better than them both [did I esteem] him that hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:4
segments: Then I saw all labor and every skilful work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:5
segments: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:6
segments: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and striving after wind.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:7
segments: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:8
segments: There is one that is alone, and he hath not a second; yea, he hath neither son nor brother; yet is there no end of all his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with riches. For whom then, [saith he], do I labor, and deprive my soul of good? This also is vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:9
segments: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:10
segments: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him that is alone when he falleth, and hath not another to lift him up.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:11
segments: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one be warm [alone]?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:12
segments: And if a man prevail against him that is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:13
segments: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king, who knoweth not how to receive admonition any more.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:14
segments: For out of prison he came forth to be king; yea, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:15
segments: I saw all the living that walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the second, that stood up in his stead.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:16
segments: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was: yet they that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a striving after wind.
